subject: Setting selectInput choices based on a variable initialized in server.R

messages.author: bda90bcea347c4f0
messages.subject: Setting selectInput choices based on a variable initialized in server.R
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to dynamically set the selectInput choices from a data.frame I load in server.R. 
The only choice that shows up is the label "Name" instead of the variables though.
What am I doing wrong?


ui.R: 
library(shiny)
library(pitchRx)

# Define UI for miles per gallon application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Application title
  headerPanel("Test App"),

  sidebarPanel(
  selectInput("variable", "Name:", list("Name" = "test$name"))
  ),

  mainPanel()
))

server.R:
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

## loads a data.frame called test
load("shinyTest.Rdat")

# Define server logic required to plot various variables against mpg
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
})


Thanks!

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Setting selectInput choices based on a variable initialized in server.R
parts:
The ui.r file can't directly access variables that are defined in server.r. If you want to load dat and have its objects available in ui.r and server.r, you'll want to create a file called global.r and load the data there. See this page for more information:
  http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#scoping


If you want to be able to change the value while the app is running, you can use dynamic UI. For an example, see:
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/dynamic_ui/
Source code at:
  https://gist.github.com/4211337

And the tutorial page at:
  http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui

-Winston
